senses.gloss: זָרֵיף (cmp. זרב) to form a rim or elevation around a wound (cmp. כָּתִית, סַפַּחַת), to cause a swelling and inflammation.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:8">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מִיזְרַף זָרֵיף</he> the operation with the hand creates soreness.
<cite ref="Chullin 77a:10">Ḥull. 77ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 76a:7">Yeb. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>פרזלא מז׳ ז׳</he> cutting with an iron tool causes inflammation.
